generations.name: Battery-electric C-HR
generations.notes: First battery-electric C-HR for North America (C-HR+ elsewhere): 77 kWh total pack (Toyota Canada; US press gives 74.7 kWh), AWD, native NACS, 10-80% in about 30 min. The earlier gas/hybrid C-HR is out of scope. I did not open a Toyota USA page for the US model year or peak DC kW; the 150 kW figure often quoted is unverified here. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://media.toyota.ca/en/releases/2025/toyota-debuts-stylish--powerful-2026-c-hr-battery-electric-vehic.html ; https://electricautonomy.ca/automakers/passenger-electric-vehicles/2026-02-19/toyotas-new-c-hr-suv-qualifies-for-canadian-ev-rebates-at-48300/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toyota_C-HR
